dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Brownie is at risk due to his behavior concerns. Brownie has not adjusted well to the care center environment is noted to alert bark and jump at handlers and was reported to lunge toward the handler when being returned to his kennel. Brownie is noted to allow petting and will display a wagging tail. Medically, Brownie has Otitis Externa.

Brownie arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as active and playful. While in care, Brownie has been observed to be fearful. Noted to become tense and retreat from handlers when they initiate contact. During his medical exam, Brownie was reported to growl, head whip, and attempt to bite when they attempted to clean his ears. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Brownie
